birks.kb_source: 0.0126 g/(MeV cm^2) (Craun & Smith 1970 / GEANT4 polystyrene) / rho 1.06 g/cm^3
birks.dedx_source: per-hit edep/step_length from consecutive-hit differences of the cumulative Sci_bar_TrackLength (cm); fallback PSTAR/ASTAR-anchored species+energy lookup (digitizer/birks.py) with per-hit ekin from the momentum branches

trigger_offset_note: 50 ns default corrects the historical 20 ns toy convention, which would place the pulse peak inside the s00 baseline window (samples 0-3) and poison baseline/amplitude/area
selection: NONE (all channels with any A-arm deposit); companion a1000 filtered
caveats: gain_adc_per_mev is an UNKNOWN placeholder (geometry-poisoned MC anchor, review P1/P2); amplitude scale is not calibrated. Phase 2 grid: trigger-consistent scan prefers ~60 ADC/MeV
per-stave occupancy/spectrum weights inherit the geometry defect (MV3 chi2/ndf=68269; Phase 2: dominated by the unsimulated two-arm coincidence trigger)
LayerID->stave mapping is UNDER REVIEW (paired vs odd, review P4)
A-arm tau_decay 50 ns is a DEFAULT (no A-stave rows in the template-fit CSV), not a data measurement
A2/A4 have no selected data pulses (docs/08_astack.md); their MC rows have no data counterpart
